residual.wall: ARAP is not a physics engine. It is a rest-shape energy. Calling tickArap an engine would replace Voigt, fight κ, and dual energy with time-integration.

question: What is ARAP as a mathematical object versus a physics engine, what does the live ArapSolver actually compute, where it sits on the Control Rig cook, and what must never be hooked as 'the engine'?
coordinateSpaces: φ live 25×40 (1000). φ̄ rest metric. φ* morph target. Content px. Face band v∈[0.32,0.58] Dirichlet. Pole r=0 one DOF. Contour512 is a sample of the rim, not the ARAP mesh. Time t only enters via Voigt k=1-exp(-dt/τ) on the predict, not in E_ARAP.
physicalLaw: ARAP energy (Igarashi 2005, 2D): E = Σ_{ij} w_ij || (p_i−p_j) − R_i (p̄_i−p̄_j) ||². Local: R_i = 2D Kabsch = atan2(S21−S12, S11+S22). Global: Poisson L p = b with L factored at morph change. No mass. No velocity. No collision.
A physics engine is (x,v) + forces + integrator + contacts. XPBD is C(φ)=0 with compliance α̃=α/dt². Kelvin–Voigt is σ=Eε+ηė. Those are engines / materials. ARAP is a projector onto local rigidity.

Lawful one-tick stack (prior arap-constraints + Control Rig): (1) Forwards writes handles onto bones. (2) Voigt predict on FREE verts only. (3) Hard Dirichlet: face, pole, pins. (4) ARAP local+global energy. (5) κ-box G¹. (6) closedSpline. Stretch α=0 after ARAP is illegal — it undoes R_i.
Rest metric: pearl Γ for rest/gait. φ* itself for paddle/remote. Rebuild L when morph id changes. Never per frame.
Live ArapSolver.ts: local atan2 + Jacobi global (next_i = Σ w (p_j + R (p̄_i−p̄_j)) / Σ w) + projectStretch. Not Cholesky. UNHOOKED. Does not write #body.
Mute ARAP = passthrough of incoming contour. Iters are energy steps, not a clock.
